map.在设定时长内连续点击，CPS = 总次数 ÷ 时长（次/秒）；按阈值分级：慢 <: Click continuously within the set duration; CPS = total clicks / duration (clicks/sec); grade by threshold: slow <5, average 5-7.9, good 8-10.9, very fast 11-13.9, blazing >=14.
map.5 秒点 40 次 → CPS=40÷5=8.0，评级「不错」；点 65 次则: 40 clicks in 5 s -> CPS = 40/5 = 8.0, rated "good"; 65 clicks gives 13.0, "very fast". Ordinary players commonly hit 6-10; >14 is mostly auto-clickers or extreme speed.
map.用时 = (当前时间戳 − 开始时间戳) ÷ 1000（秒）；剩余 = max(: Elapsed = (now − start) ÷ 1000 (s); remaining = max(0, duration − elapsed); live CPS = clicks ÷ max(elapsed, 0.001) to avoid division by zero; final CPS = clicks ÷ duration, best is the historical maximum; grades: below 5 slow, below 8 average, below 11 good, below 14 very fast, otherwise blazing.
